name: primitives-headless-dialog
title: Headless Dialog
description: A white Open Dialog button opens a dark panel warning that a project will be archived, with a short explanation and Cancel and Archive actions; it tilts in with a blur.
use: A destructive or irreversible action needs a confirming panel with explanation and two choices.
avoid: It is renderless, so every bit of spacing, colour and button styling has to be written by you.
a11y: Focus is trapped, Escape closes and the title and description are wired up, but no focus-visible styles or reduced-motion check are included. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded panel centred on a dimmed page, headed Archive this project? in bold white, with three lines of grey explanation and two buttons at the bottom right: an outlined Cancel and a white Archive.
behaves: Clicking Open Dialog drops a softly blurred black backdrop over the page and tilts the panel in from the top with a spring, sharpening as it settles. Cancel, Archive, Escape or a backdrop click close it the same way in reverse.
customise: Open state, close handler and every part are passed in; panel direction, spring, backdrop transition and class names are props while the inner markup is yours.
weight: light: One backdrop and one panel animate; nothing runs while closed.
